shared_anchors: Indian River County early voting ends Saturday before the Tuesday, Nov. 3 General Election.
Both describe the same regional early-voting period on the Treasure Coast.
Both instruct Election Day voters to use their assigned precinct and explain the 7 p.m. vote-by-mail receipt deadline.
novel_facts: The incoming article confirms that the scheduled Saturday early-voting period has ended.
It reports nearly 56,000 early votes in St. Lucie County, around 29,000 each in Martin and Indian River counties, and more than 3,700 in Okeechobee County.
Martin County officials report that more than 40% of registered voters voted early or by mail.
Palm Beach County continued early voting Sunday at 28 sites.
material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: Both articles cover the same election's regional early-voting deadline. The incoming report adds routine turnout figures, scheduled closure confirmation and voting reminders, but no changed voting rules, election outcome, disruption or distinct accountability development warranting an update or separate URL.

material_update_promotion_decisions.canonical_headline: Three killed, including 5-year-old boy, in I-95 crash in Martin County
shared_anchors: Late Saturday crash around 11:05 p.m. on northbound I-95 in northern Martin County
Toyota Camry struck a tractor-trailer parked on the right shoulder and spun across three lanes
Three Camry passengers killed: a 34-year-old man, a 5-year-old boy and a woman
31-year-old female Camry driver and 11-year-old girl injured; 60-year-old Miami truck driver uninjured
Northbound traffic diverted at Martin Highway
novel_facts: Incoming names St. Mary’s Medical Center as the Camry driver's destination
Incoming reports northbound lanes reopened after 5 a.m.
material_update_promotion_decisions.reason: The identical source URL and matching crash circumstances establish the same incident. The canonical already includes the three deaths, victims' ages, injuries and collision sequence. The added mile marker, hospital destination and reopening time are routine details, not material developments or an independently newsworthy follow-up.
